title: Magnific AI Automation (2026 Guide)
summary: Magnific AI automation enables developers to integrate high-resolution upscaling into existing production pipelines for batch image processing.
body_markdown:
## Automate Magnific AI workflows using Activepieces


Activepieces transforms Magnific AI from a standalone enhancement tool into a functional node within a broader business logic engine. By treating the API as a discrete step in a visual workflow, you eliminate the manual hand-off between storage, processing, and distribution.


The moment a Magnific integration is connected in Activepieces, an agent can call it as a tool. Registering a integration once allows it to run as a step in a flow or as a tool schema on the per-project MCP server, reachable from an agent you built yourself. Check the Integrations Framework in the open source repo to see how the same action that runs in a flow is exposed as an MCP tool. This allows a creative agent to trigger an upscale directly from a chat interface without a separate integration step.


### Triggering upscales from new Google Drive uploads


Automated ingestion ensures that every raw asset intended for production undergoes high-fractality enhancement without a designer manually moving files between browser tabs.


When a new file lands in a watched Google Drive folder, Activepieces captures the file metadata and passes the public URL directly to the Magnific API. A photographer can sync a local folder to the cloud and trigger a fleet of upscales simply by saving a file.


### Sending enhanced images to Slack or Discord for approval


The visual workflow below demonstrates how a production pipeline handles external events by routing success or failure notifications to the teams that need them.


The canvas illustrates a Stripe failure trigger, but the logic remains identical for creative workflows. A "Job Completed" signal from Magnific triggers a Slack "Send Message to a Channel" action.


Activepieces records every agent tool call, the specific image data it processed, and the sequence of its logic in a unified trace alongside the fixed workflow steps. Check the Run Details and Debugging UI for this per-step agent decision trace, which ensures that an agent's choice of Magnific parameters is reviewed the same way a workflow's steps are. MoneyGram and Moneypenny run Activepieces in production to manage these complex environments where auditability is required.


### Bulk processing Airtable records with Magnific AI


Relational databases like Airtable are the source of truth for high-volume creative campaigns. Activepieces iterates through these records, sending the image URL to Magnific and then writing the enhanced output back into an attachment field once the API returns the result.


This structured approach permanently links every upscaled version to its original metadata and project ID.
